description: Hochwasserrisiko - Kilometrierung der saarländischen Gewässer is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Kilometry (continuous kilometre counting) of Saarland waters. When kilometriating, you usually start at the mouth with the zero mark. Attributes: STATION: Kilometers of WATER: Water name GEWKZ: Water classification according to LAWA KM: kilometre. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Flood risk - Kilometry of Saarland waters" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Saarland, Blies, Geowissenschaften, HOCHWASSER_kilometrierung, geoportal. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
